claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM fluspirilene is expected to kill cancer cells primarily via voltage-gated calcium channel blockade and disruption of calcium/calpain/autophagy signaling, with a likely additional contribution from CDK2 inhibition; its dopamine receptor antagonism is unlikely to be the main cytotoxic driver.
